historical_commentary.text: This is a pure web-UI styling technique tied entirely to the discontinued 4D Ajax Framework's Data Grid component; the specific API/class names no longer exist in any current 4D product. CSS styling itself remains a universal web skill, but the underlying grid object and its JS hooks are gone.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has been fully discontinued; modern 4D web UIs are built with the 4D web server, REST/ORDA, and Qodly Studio (2021+) low-code web components
Grid/table styling today is typically handled via modern JS frameworks or Qodly's built-in table component, not manual CSS hooks into a legacy Data Grid object
